title: PsychSwap
tagline: Personality-driven DeFi routing that gamifies financial behavior while providing genuine utility.
description:
PsychSwap is a personality-driven decentralized finance (DeFi) routing protocol that gamifies the user experience while offering real financial utility. The core idea behind PsychSwap is to blend behavioral psychology with decentralized finance to create a more engaging and personalized swapping experience.

Users begin their journey on PsychSwap by either taking a short, interactive quiz or directly selecting their Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) personality type. This personality insight is then used as a behavioral lens to route their token swaps through the most psychologically aligned and efficient liquidity paths, using the powerful aggregation engine of the 1inch API.

Rather than focusing solely on numbers and charts, PsychSwap introduces a gamified interface that tailors swap suggestions to the user's cognitive and emotional traits. For example, a user classified as an ENTP may be nudged toward higher-risk, high-reward pools, while an ISTJ might be guided toward stablecoin pairs with predictable returns. This fusion of psychological profiling and smart contract infrastructure creates a dynamic ecosystem where users are not only optimizing yield but doing so in a way that feels intuitive and uniquely personal.

By turning DeFi interactions into a personality-driven game, PsychSwap not only enhances user retention and decision-making but also demystifies the complexities of DeFi for a broader audience. Whether you're a cautious thinker or a bold adventurer, PsychSwap offers a novel way to explore, learn, and earn within the Web3 space, rooted in who you are.
how_its_made:
The PsychSwap platform is built using a modern, robust, and modular technology stack designed to ensure performance, scalability, and seamless user experience. At the heart of the front-end architecture is Next.js, a powerful React framework that enables server-side rendering, static site generation, and dynamic routing all essential for delivering a fast and responsive user interface. This allows PsychSwap to load quickly, adapt to user behavior, and support both SEO-friendly content and Web3 interactions.

For styling and layout, Tailwind CSS is employed to streamline the design process and maintain a consistent aesthetic across components. Its utility-first approach allows for rapid prototyping and efficient customization, ensuring a clean, responsive, and visually appealing user interface that feels modern and intuitive.

To manage user authentication and wallet connections, Privy is integrated. Privy enables secure and seamless onboarding for both Web3-native users and those new to crypto by allowing sign-in with email, social accounts, or non-custodial wallets all while abstracting away the complexities of wallet management. This lowers the barrier to entry and enhances the accessibility of the platform.

On the smart contract and blockchain interaction layer, Foundry is utilized as the development and testing framework. Foundry provides a powerful CLI toolset and a high-performance testing environment for writing, deploying, and auditing smart contracts in Solidity. It ensures reliable, secure, and gas-efficient contract development for the DeFi logic underlying PsychSwap.

The smart contracts themselves are written in Solidity, the industry-standard programming language for Ethereum-based smart contracts. These contracts handle critical functionalities such as swap execution, personality-to-token mapping logic, and integration with external protocols.

To source the most efficient and cost-effective swap routes, PsychSwap taps into the 1inch API, a leading DEX aggregator. By leveraging 1inch’s advanced routing algorithms, users are always offered the most optimal token swap path, ensuring maximum return and minimum slippage, tailored through the behavioral filter provided by the MBTI-based personalization.

Altogether, this technology stack empowers PsychSwap to deliver a secure, high-performance, and deeply personalized DeFi experience, combining the best of Web2 design principles with cutting-edge Web3 infrastructure.
